promises.quote: We will ask the trust for the action they intend to take because of this Prevention of Future Deaths Report and monitor those actions as part of our ongoing monitoring and engagement with them.
promises.summary: Ask trust for intended actions and monitor them

promises.quote: NHS England has published a summary of existing guidance on the deployment of medical associate professions for NHS organisations. This guidance makes it clear that all staff should introduce themselves and their role clearly and be supported by their employer to do so.
promises.summary: Publish guidance on staff role introductions

promises.quote: RCEM issued a position statement in October 2024 regarding patients who may require a laparotomy [7]; this statement highlights that some patients are at greater risk of requiring surgery and part of this group includes the older person and those with cognitive impairment.
promises.summary: RCEM updated guidance on supervision of Physician Associates in emergency departments, requiring senior consultant review for high‑risk patients.

promises.quote: the Department notes that the report has been sent to a number of medical Royal Colleges and professional bodies relating to anaesthesia. We think these organisations are best placed to respond to points 6, 7 and 8 of your report which relate specifically to guidelines around anaesthesia therefore our response focuses on points 1 - 5 only.
promises.summary: Refer anaesthesia guideline concerns to medical Royal Colleges and professional bodies.
